newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bull say share sale oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Bull say share sale oversubscribed.

text.p: Cie des Machines Bull said on Wednesay that its offering of 17.1 million shares to institutional and individual investors was oversubscribed.

It said in a statement that over 70,000 individuals had requested more than 21 times as many shares as were set aside for them, while more than 150 institutions had asked for 16 times as many shares as were available.
Bull said that quotation of Bull shares, suspended on April 14 for the offering, would resume on May 2.
France had launched the sale of Bull shares on April 23.

The Bull statement said that 32 percent of the institutional shares would be held by French firms, 35 percent by British firms, 20 percent by firms from other European nations and 13 percent by firms from non-European nations.
"These figures reflect Bull's desire to be a Europe-wide high-tech investment," Bull said.
The sale of the shares will reduce France's stake in Bull to 17 percent from 30.5 percent.
Other Bull shareholders include France Telecom, with 18.7 percent, NEC Corp of Japan and Motorola Inc.
